articles.title: Jefferies warns of crypto market volatility as Clarity Act faces Senate test
articles.snippet: The bank said the bill faces major hurdles, with passage boosting institutional crypto adoption and delays prolonging regulatory uncertainty.

articles.title: Nasdaq expands distribution of its market data into blockchain infrastructure
articles.snippet: The exchange operator will offer its TotalView data feed through Pyth's marketplace as financial firms increasingly build applications on blockchain rails.

articles.title: UK to lower stablecoin capital buffers, undercutting EU's MiCA requirements
articles.snippet: The Financial Conduct Authority's proposal follows the Bank of England's backtracking on the limit to the value of stablecoins an individual could hold.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls back below $59,000, Circle's stock gets crushed
articles.snippet: IBIT alone shed $300 million while smaller funds absorbed some of the outflow. The selloff lands as the same AI trade that crashed Korea a week ago now powers a record quarterly rally there.

articles.title: MetaMask launches stablecoin yield account with card spending
articles.snippet: MetaMask launches Money Account it says offers up to 4% variable APY on mUSD stablecoin balances and card spending, with DeFi-powered yield via vaults, excluding the UK and sanctioned jurisdictions.
